notes.title: Skillwood v0.22.5 - prestige upgrades hotfix
notes.content:
I could've done it earlier, but I'm a little bit low on motivation lately. Hope I can keep going with ~monthly updates as usual.

Changelog:
- Maxing out AOE blast skill damage multiplier won't make it deal 0 damage anymore. Thanks to @bz-mof, @Xen, @Lamey the Clown and @Blue64 for letting me know about the issue
- Changed UI behaviour of prestige upgrades, now they don't hide upgrade value on max out and only hide next level souls requirements (since you can't upgrade it any further)
- Fixed next level upgrade cost in portal confirmation dialog. It crashed the game in dev mode and could've bring some problems into production build too.


Thanks everyone. I hope I can write a post in discussions about further plans on the game. As you might've noticed, the game is a little experiment - incremental game under the sauce of survival/farming game. And this "sauce" shot me in the knee, since it brought the expectations for survival/farming scope game, that I didn't planned to do. There won't be enemies, farming, cooking and so on. I want to keep making it as a basic incremental game with a relaxing wibe, nothing too overwhelming. I know it won't be enough for some players, but I hope there will be still people who can enjoy it.

notes.title: Skillwood v0.22.4 - blast skill and combo meter
notes.content:
I'm late almost for a week with an update log, but some of you might already play the new version. Sorry for being late, I have a strange excuse, but I do version preview covers in a strange way in game and capturing blast was quite tricky. 

Also, v0.22.3 was a bug fix uploaded a long ago, so I didn't even bother to post a release note.

[h1]Skillwood - v0.22.4[/h1]

[h2]Combo skills[/h2]

Now you can see a combo meter above hitbar. It increases every time you land a perfect hit in the green area and resets when you do a non perfect hit or over time. 

There's only one skill right now, from start every 30 perfect hit will trigger blast that will hit additionally the tree or rock that you just hit and other rocks and trees nearby. You can upgrade damage multiplier and decrease combo count needed with new prestige upgrades. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/26ede45673f247aa541831cf7baa20d37850286a.gif[/img]

[h2]New map[/h2]

Now on top of the existing map after prestiging there is an alternative map so the prestige would feel less repetative. Since I still don't have procedural generation this thing took me a week to do, this is an unreasonable level of maunal work, so I hope it at least helps with repetativeness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/bb967791bb2bf5d7cb613948f01ad26afd65a043.png[/img]

[h2]Player monuments[/h2]

I added the player monuments to prestige world so you can change the player any time you prestige. Right now there's still only two players, but I hope to fix it in future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/58ea5e0ba77bb419140eaadd45b50c7461e82693.png[/img]

notes.title: Skillwood v0.22.2 - new basalt area

notes.title: Skillwood - Early access release - v0.22.0
notes.content:
Skillwood finally enters Early Access. I think I kept it in demo for too long already, since I see there's enough content to play for an early access version. I supported demo version since january and you helped me a lot with giving feedback, which I used to improve the game. In this perspective nothing will change. Game is still free, I will still listen to your feedback and try to reply in discussions. 
The only new thing in this perspective - is the [url=https://discord.gg/MX8Gagsws7]discord account of the game[/url]. I'm keeping track of my plans, send there future features and track bugs too. I still have my vision, so sometimes we can have different opinions on where the game should go, but I'll still try to listen to feedback and look behind the words of what flaw of the game might make one want something.

And here goes the traditional part.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Character selection[/h2]

Now you can pick one of two default characters to play for. Right now there are only two, but there's a good fundament for further extension. Also, you might notice I did the second character sprite much later as it has little things like hair movement. Hope you like it too

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/343a094a7455cc652e355d652e49e0c505e87cb6.gif[/img]


[h2]Steam achievements[/h2]

There are currently 11 achievements in the game which can be achieved pretty quickly. So I guess it's easy gold in 40 minutes or so. But I plan to extend the list in future, so I hope you won't be too frustrated if the "gold" will be taken away at some point. However current one are so basic and logical I don't think I will change them. Maximum - rename or change their sprites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/a1ec9c1fcca30c1302444b5da2f20b225ab613f8.png[/img]


[h2]Prestige UI updates[/h2]

These updates are based on feedback in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2776630/discussions/0/4343239199135830967/]steam discussions[/url] and in discord. The main updates are:
[list]
[*] Now in prestige confirm dialog you can see informations how many upgrades you can buy if you always buy the cheapest one and how many more souls you need to earn to buy one more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/bc4a0d4071f8cc32009f03b3b7ca56d20603caf8.png[/img]

[*] Before exiting prestige world back to the main one there's a confirm dialog too. And it shows you how many more upgrades you can buy right now in case you forgot to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/205ea4fc8fd65cc2f759be97091c16ce4b9d7ed9.png[/img]
[/list]


[h2]Music and sounds[/h2]

I tried to make main menu more alive, so I created simple background music for it and also created sound effects for ui elements like buttons and sliders. I recieved feedback about silent menu multiple times so the main menu background music was in the wait list for too long already.
No screenshot's here cause it's, you know, sounds.


[h2]Other updates and fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced first forest: made second level upgrades cheaper and added more berry bushes. Game ended up being grindy so I tried to at least minimize it in the first upgradable area.
[*] Rebalanced sticks to logs barter. Now you need less sticks for the first NPC. You didn't have too much stick source anyway, so this barter became very stick bushes dependant, which I tried to manage somehow
[*] Added new sticky bushes to starter area. For the same reason as written above. The update is not so big, but it almost double the amount of sticky bushes, so it should make sticks to logs trade even easier
[*] Fixed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2776630/discussions/0/6853996208326532867/]this [/url]bug of game crashing sometimes when you prestige. It was quite a journey to find it. Hope I succeeded 
[*] Save player world wherever you are in prestige world or in main world. So when you exited game while presting and load it afterwards you end up in the prestige world, so you can buy all the upgrades and don't wait for the next prestige.
[/list]



Thank everyone for the support up to this moment. I hope you will enjoy the early access version too. And please, don't forget about the discord to stay in tune with the upcoming plans.
Discord: https://discord.gg/MX8Gagsws7

notes.title: Demo v0.21.1 - ironwood forest area
notes.content:
Not so much time left until steam next fest and yet, I'm still posting update notes several days late as usual. Consistency is my second name, what else can I say.

[h2]New area - Sandstone desert[/h2]

Since the game has natural area progression wood->mineral->wood->mineral the next area should be next tier wood. Since I aleady had regular green forest and autumn hardwood forest my first intention was to make some sort of winter forest. But winter match better with the softwood trees like pines and
1. Softwood isn't better then hardwood, so it doesn't have sence having it better wood then the previous one
2. I already did an area with this types of trees.

So I decided to go the other way and see how far can I get with staying close to reality with wood types without adding wood refinement. So I found the real prototype for my ironwood trees and made the whole area based on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/7e15b598b72668199958cc53cf1839b66ed83f62.gif[/img]

Since there's an npc in each area now I also added this little guy, that have mask\scarf to cover his face in the desert.

[h2]Other updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added sound to trading with npc
[*] Rebalanced trees and stones to be less grindy
[*] Fixed render order of hitbar so it doesn't get hidden behidn trees and bird

notes.title: Demo v0.21.0 - trader NPCs
notes.content:
[h1]Demo v0.21.0[/h1]

I think it's the biggest feature since addition of food and can change core gameplay loop

[h2]Barter NPCs [/h2]

Now after upgrading area twice the NPC will spawn. Each area has it's own unique NPC:

Forest:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/a9a9b3a2f035030264bffab0feb85d3633a993c9.png[/img] 

Limestone:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/57dd8f3a78fc18fb789c7126db7702aca09a7f52.png[/img] 

Hardwood forest:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/d129e3fa934a5f6860364902290817679b9d0a29.png[/img] 

Sandstone desert:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/ec0affedd97c41e6a416fdf7a23d281cb365db8f.png[/img]

Each of them mine their own resources, depnding on area they are in. And after they finish you can trade their resources for lower tier ones. Softwood logs for sticks, limestone for softwood, hardwood for limestone and sandstone for hardwood. Ratio is tweaked to be more profitable for player, but the tier of resource still counts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/0071cbafece69bb3d321d326cbd1434b333f5061.gif[/img]

After trading several times NPC will level up and will provide both better and bigger trade offers. This could help with both automatization and with utilizing lower tier resources, which ended up being completely useless at some moment of the game.

[h2]Side effects[/h2]

Adding objects earlier on areas upgrading allowed to unlock other things earlier. So I made skill workbenches and woodpecker birdhouse unlocked after the first upgrade of areas, since I noticed that some players didn't upgrade areas enough to reach these things. Now since all more content will be available eariler I hope less content will go unnoticed

notes.title: Demo v0.20.0 - prestige and meta progression
notes.content:
[h1]Demo v0.20.0[/h1]

[h2]Souls system[/h2]

[b]Added souls obtaining for area upgrades.[/b] After areas update game started to revolve more around not only upgrading your skills, but also upgrading playable environment by adding more trees, rocks and food. Now it's additionally encouraged by receiving new type of currency for that - souls. Later they will be used in prestige area, where you can obtain upgrades that will remain with you between play runs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/9ed49154544fae76894d55f741e7ab1d8695dd39.gif[/img]

[h2]Prestige bonuses[/h2]

After obtaining of certain amount of souls portal near player spawnpoint will open. After you enter the portal you will teleport to the special prestige area, where you can spend earned souls on permanent bonuses that will persist you between runs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/0bb16790666c5a8ec784f2119937be374bc68004.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Loot bonus - adds additional loot item after finishing a tree or a rock. Works better for smaller objects
[*] Loot multiplier - multiplies loot after finishing a tree or a rock, doesn't multiply bonus. Works better for bigger objects
[*] Souls multiplier - multiplies souls obtained in core game from upgrading areas
[*] Damage multiplier - multiplies strength of chopping and mining
[*] Food spawn speed - decreases time needed for food to regrow
[*] Objects spawn speed - decreases time needed for trees and rocks to respawn
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/8e99ff1afa06d3ae37e44adfe7564c2ef7d63d26.gif[/img]

[h2]Further plans[/h2]

After two big updates (0.19.0 areas and 0.20.0 prestige) that create the basic picture of gameplay I'm not thinking of adding game breaking features in the next month or two. My top further priorities in close/mid perspective:

[list]
[*] Quality of life improvements - more tutorials, better sound configuration not with turn on and off, intermediate animations and so on. Just making the game more polished in a good way
[*] Rebalance - I tried to actually calculate the meta gameplay progressions with spreadsheets and stuff for souls upgrades with how many can you earn by the run with certain multiplier bonus, so the progression can be smoother. However it might still ruin core gameplay with hitting trees and rocks. So hits might become stronger or weaker, and trees and rocks might give more or less loot. This kind of rebalance
[*] New areas - the idea of progression by type of material is a classic thing for the genre: ores in Minecraft or Starbound, woods (regular and hardwood) in Stardew Valley or minerals type progression like in Humankind: Odyssey (that's a masterpiece). So my game has the same  idea behind it. I planned to make areas with basalt and obsidian months ago, but I decided to make the gameplay a little deeper before I start expanding the game horizontally. Now I think the game is ready for new areas with new trees and rocks to be added 
[*] New unique unlockable mechanics - Even though the woodpecker took a lot of time to implement I think adding unique mechanics after maxing out the area is a good thing. Sandstone desert is already made for further updates with grindstones temporal buff, but more areas might come with more mechanics.
[/list] 



P.S.
It's a small game from pretty niche genre, so I didn't have much expectations from the community. That's why I'm grateful for each thread in the discussions section. Feel free to write about how you feel about the game. This kind of feedback is really valuable for solo developers like myself
